task: Develop/evaluate Uncalled4-style nanopore signal-to-reference alignment toolkit using provided feature/performance/modification datasets.
explicit_inputs: FAST5/POD5 raw signal (not provided as raw files)
basecalled reads (not provided as raw files)
reference genome/transcriptome sequences (not provided as raw files)
k-mer pore models (provided as CSV pore-model tables)
explicit_outputs_requested: nucleotide modification calls such as m6A
workspace_feasible_scope: No raw FAST5/POD5/read/reference files are present; analysis therefore evaluates provided pore-model tables, performance_summary.csv, and m6A prediction/label tables rather than generating BAMs or retraining from raw signal.
primary_comparisons: Uncalled4 vs f5c/Nanopolish/Tombo benchmark time and output file size by chemistry
Uncalled4 vs Nanopolish alignment-derived m6A prediction performance
DNA R9.4.1 6-mer vs DNA R10.4.1 9-mer pore-model substitution effects
RNA R9.4.1 5-mer vs RNA004 9-mer signal/composition relationships
validation_required: limitations separating provided-data verification from unavailable raw-signal tasks
